alex_sales: Kickoff for Nimbus POC: validate sustained 1k qps, p99 <200ms for short chat prompts. Wed 9–11 PST. Need ops + SRE + SE + pricing.

maya_se: Quick Qs: homogeneous short prompts (2530 tokens) or mixed with tails? Which model & quant?

zach_sre: Recommend baseline short prompts + 10% long tails. I'll run `wrk -t12 -c1200 -d30m --latency` against the dedicated-poc endpoint.

maya_se: Use prod-7b-8k-quant, batch_size=8, enable prefix-cache. Do a KV-warmup step (~100k tokens) before steady run.

ops_bot: deploy: canary to dedicated-poc-cluster 08:30 PST, dashboards created: /dash/poc/nimbus-heartbeat.

emma_research: Pricing Q: rough hourly for 1k qps on Dedicated? Conservative slide number: $6k/hr (reserved GPU + infra + support) — detailed breakdown after runs.

zach_sre: Security note: Nimbus needs customer-managed KMS/HSM for prod. For POC we can use redwood-managed keys with strict ephemeral attestations; provisioning external KMS adds ~3 business days.

maya_se: Ops checklist for Wed: prewarm KV (maya), provision temp KMS (zach), bench machines + scripts (ops), pricing slide + SOW stub (alex), share dashboard with Nimbus sec (zach).

ops_bot: runbook ticket RB-4217 created.

alex_sales: I'll confirm with Nimbus and share calendar + post the short-run results + 1-page summary here. :thumbsup:
